chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Al-Hakam Al-Khayyat, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Do I accept the garment for one dirham and deliver it for less than that, without increasing [the price] except by splitting it?' He said, 'There is no harm in that.' Then he said, 'There is no harm in what you accepted from work, then you increased [the price].'

key_terms.أَشُقَّهُ: I split it / I divide it (referring to splitting the price or term)
key_terms.أُسَلِّمُهُ: I deliver it / I hand it over

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to increase rent if a tenant keeps a leased item longer than the agreed period?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) validates the permissibility of *ijarah* (leasing) where the rent is tied to the duration of use, specifically allowing the landlord to charge extra if the tenant retains the garment beyond the agreed term. This ruling underscores the flexibility in commercial contracts within Shia jurisprudence, emphasizing that additional compensation for extended benefit or usage is legally sound (*la ba'sa*), provided it is mutually agreed upon and not usurious.
